study_note: Four fresh Humanoid Walk state runs cross automatic SAC entropy targets -10.5 and -21 with auxiliary-critic representation gradients attached or detached. The additional independent reward-only critic bootstraps from the SAC actor; no return actor exists. Collection uses the stochastic SAC prior without inner optimization or MPPI. Both critic losses have coefficient 0.1; actor Q is mean-pair and target Q is min-pair. All runs use seed 55, 2 million decisions, 2500 warmup decisions and 2500 pretraining updates, and retain all 80 scheduled checkpoints per run. This is a single-seed exploratory comparison, not confirmatory evidence. Full algorithm recipes are versioned without alg_params overrides.
